text: I can trace a request from edge to GPU and say which hop enforces quotas, picks the region, applies prefix affinity and budgets KV memory.
I can turn daily active users into peak tokens per second, concurrent streams (Little's law with TPOT), replicas and GPUs, then check prefill compute and add regional headroom.
I can design priority tiers and token-based fair queuing, and explain when to return a 429 versus an overload error.
I can write a router scoring rule that balances prefix-cache affinity against load and explain how it fails with a hot prefix.
I can explain why GPU scale-out takes minutes and list the fleet-level alternatives: headroom, spillover, preemptible batch tiers and degradation.
I can compute the cost of a retry mid-stream and design stream resumption with idempotent tool calls.
